title: Most Of The Time
subtitle: Most of the time = on most occasions / during most of a period / in the majority of ordina

Always — on every occasion without exception。always 表示每一次都如此，沒有例外，明顯比 most of the time 強。
Sometimes — on some occasions。sometimes 只表示部分時候，頻率明顯較低。
Occasionally — from time to time, but not often。occasionally 表示偶爾，與『大多數時候』相差很遠。

words.meaning: 大致上；多半；大部分情況下

falseSynonyms.zh: 總是 ≠ most of the time always 表示毫無例外，強度過高。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Always means on every occasion.

falseSynonyms.zh: 經常 ≠ necessarily most of the time often 表示頻繁，但不一定達到『大多數時候』。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Often may be weaker than most of the time.

falseSynonyms.zh: 有時 ≠ most of the time sometimes 只表示部分時候，明顯較弱。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Sometimes is much weaker.

falseSynonyms.zh: 偶爾 ≠ most of the time occasionally 表示低頻率，幾乎相反。
只在概括 sense 高度接近 generally 偏『一般而言』，不一定是逐次頻率。
只在正常情況 sense 高度接近 normally 暗示 normal circumstances。
只在整體概括 sense 接近 它可以描述整體狀態，而非事件發生次數。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON For the most part is broad-overall.
